title: Investigation of the linear and nonlinear optical properties in the crystalline phase of a pyrimidine derivative—a potential nonlinear optical material: analysis of its structure, reactivity, and docking studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37709-37724
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05681G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Krishna Murthy Potla, Yahya I Asiri, Nannapaneni Usha Rani, Francisco A. P. Osório, Clodoaldo Valverde, Murugesan Raja, Sanja J. Armaković, Stevan Armaković
In this study, we examined the nonlinear optical properties of a pyrimidine derivative in its crystalline phase using an iterative electrostatic method (IEM) to explore its potential applications in developing new nonlinear optical materials.
